أستهتر (form X)
# أَسْتَهْتِرُ (ʔastahtiru) /ʔas.tah.ti.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهْتَرَ (istahtara)
# أَسْتَهْتِرَ (ʔastahtira) /ʔas.tah.ti.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَهْتَرَ (istahtara)
# أَسْتَهْتِرْ (ʔastahtir) /ʔas.tah.tir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَهْتَرَ (istahtara)
